fredo.description: Leader and orchestrator. Receives user directives, confirms understanding, delegates to subagents via HANDOFF blocks, manages spec branches, and drives the full SDD lifecycle to completion.

fredo-spec-arch.description: Software architect. Creates specs with independent sub-issues, creates spec branches, makes technical decisions, and reviews PRs. Does not write code.

fredo-coder.description: Senior full-stack developer. Implements features against specs, branches from spec branch, opens draft PRs targeting spec branch, and fixes bugs. TDD — tests already exist on spec branch.

fredo-tester.description: Senior QA engineer. Two-phase TDD: Phase 1 writes UT + e2e stubs before code (merged first), Phase 2 runs full e2e against spec branch after all code merged.
